tasks.title: Initialize Monorepo, Build Tooling and CI Baseline
tasks.description: Establish the TypeScript monorepo structure with @rgme/core, @rgme/cli, and @rgme/web packages using pnpm workspaces and Vitest.
acceptanceCriteria: Monorepo root configured with pnpm-workspace.yaml or npm workspaces
Packages @rgme/core, @rgme/cli, @rgme/web initialized with TypeScript configs
pnpm build (or npm run build) compiles all packages with 0 errors
pnpm test runs Vitest across all workspace packages and passes

tasks.title: Implement GameProfile and Rights Intelligence Domain Schemas
tasks.description: Create strict Zod schemas and TypeScript types for GameProfile v0.2, Rights Record, and the Rights Policy Engine in @rgme/core.
acceptanceCriteria: Zod schemas and types for GameProfile, MachineConfig (A500/A600, OCS/ECS, PAL/NTSC), InputMapping, DisplayProfile
RightsRecord and EvidenceStore schemas reflecting the RGME Rights Matrix format
RightsPolicyEngine.evaluateAction() enforces the golden rule: Unknown rights never become permission by inference
Comprehensive unit tests in @rgme/core verifying valid/invalid profiles and policy decisions (allow, local_only, deny)

tasks.title: Implement RuntimeAdapter Contract and MockRuntimeAdapter
tasks.description: Define the generic RuntimeAdapter interface in @rgme/core and implement MockRuntimeAdapter for headless and browser testing.
acceptanceCriteria: RuntimeAdapter interface cleanly isolates emulator internals from game profiles and UI
Methods: identifyCapabilities, loadGame, start, pause, reset, saveState, loadState, setInputMapping, setDisplayProfile, insertMedia
MockRuntimeAdapter implements the interface, generates test pattern video frames on HTML5 Canvas, and manages mock save-states
Unit tests in @rgme/core verifying adapter state transitions (UNLOADED -> LOADED -> RUNNING -> PAUSED -> STOPPED)

tasks.title: Implement Local File Ingestion and Rights Resolver in @rgme/cli
tasks.description: Build the CLI command to scan directories for Amiga ADF disk images, compute SHA-256 hashes, and match against rights records.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI command 'rgme scan <directory>' recursively discovers .adf files without modifying them
Streaming SHA-256 calculation for low memory overhead
Resolver matches hash/metadata against Rights Matrix dataset and outputs formatted table
Generates declarative GameProfile YAML file for identified titles
Unit and fixture tests verifying scanner output against sample ADF hashes

tasks.title: Build Web Player Shell with Design System and Viewport in @rgme/web
tasks.description: Create the modern web interface using Vite, React, and the RGME design tokens with Amiga heritage accents and CRT simulation.
acceptanceCriteria: Design tokens from .skillweave/design/rgme-design-system.md implemented in CSS/Tailwind
Drag-and-drop ADF file ingestion zone with client-side SHA-256 hash calculation
GameProfile inspector component showing machine specs, chipset, and color-coded Rights badge
Canvas viewport component with 4:3 PAL aspect-ratio preservation and togglable CRT scanline shader
Virtual gamepad HUD with Amiga joystick/button mapping indicators

tasks.title: End-to-End M1 Demonstrator Integration and Verification
tasks.description: Integrate @rgme/web with MockRuntimeAdapter and sample profiles, verify full ingestion-to-launch flow, and enforce test gates.
acceptanceCriteria: Web shell launches mock game on canvas upon loading profile or dropping demo ADF
Rights policy correctly blocks unauthorized actions and displays badge
Keyboard controls translate to Amiga joystick inputs with visual feedback in HUD
Full test suite across monorepo passes with zero errors and test report generated
